generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model Room {
  id        String        @id @default(cuid())
  name      String        @unique
  capacity  Int
  floor     String?
  createdAt DateTime      @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime      @updatedAt
  bookings  Booking[]
  amenities RoomAmenity[]
}

model User {
  id        String    @id @default(cuid())
  name      String
  email     String    @unique
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt
  bookings  Booking[]
}

model Booking {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  roomId    String
  userId    String
  title     String
  startsAt  DateTime
  endsAt    DateTime
  status    String   @default("ACTIVE")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
  room      Room     @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([roomId, startsAt])
}

model Amenity {
  id          String        @id @default(cuid())
  name        String        @unique
  description String?
  rooms       RoomAmenity[]
}

model RoomAmenity {
  roomId    String
  amenityId String
  room      Room    @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  amenity   Amenity @relation(fields: [amenityId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([roomId, amenityId])
}

input.new_string:
# Changelog

## Unreleased

- Fixed booking conflict detection to catch overlaps where a new booking fully engulfs an existing one; `PATCH /bookings/:id` now also checks for conflicts when the room or time changes.
- Booking creation and updates now run inside a transaction with retry-on-write-conflict, closing a race where two concurrent requests for the same slot could both succeed.
- Added `GET /bookings/availability` to list free time slots for a room over a period.
- Added `POST /bookings/batch` to create multiple bookings in one request, with per-item results instead of failing the whole batch on the first conflict.

## 1.0.0

- Rooms, users, bookings and amenities endpoints.
- Pagination on list endpoints.
- Conflict detection when creating a booking.

# meeting-rooms-api

REST API for booking meeting rooms.

## Requirements

Node 22 and GNU Make.

## Commands

```bash
make setup      # install dependencies and prepare the database
make dev        # run in watch mode
make test       # run the test suite
make verify     # typecheck, lint, build and test
make demo-data  # load sample rows for local browsing
```

The API listens on the port given by `PORT`, default 3000.

Good — `data/` and `.cache/` are gitignored, so the local DB/schema-hash changes from `prisma db push` don't pollute the diff. All 4 phases of the plan are implemented and verified:

## Resumo do que foi implementado

**Fase 1 — correção do bug de sobreposição + corrida:**
- `repository.ts`: `findConflictAtStart` virou `findConflict(roomId, startsAt, endsAt, excludeId?, client?)` com overlap correto (`existing.startsAt < new.endsAt AND existing.endsAt > new.startsAt`), aceitando um client transacional opcional.
- `service.ts`: `createBooking` e `updateBooking` agora rodam dentro de `prisma.$transaction`, com retry em conflito de escrita (`P2034`). `updateBooking` passou a checar conflito quando `roomId`/`startsAt`/`endsAt` mudam (antes não checava nada).

**Fase 2 — disponibilidade:** `GET /bookings/availability?roomId&from&to` retorna os intervalos livres da sala no período (`repository.listActiveInRange` + `service.getAvailability`).

**Fase 3 — criação em lote:** `POST /bookings/batch` aceita 1–20 reservas numa chamada e devolve resultado por item (`created`/`failed`), sem descartar as que deram certo por causa de um conflito isolado.

**Fase 4 — acabamento:** índice `@@index([roomId, endsAt])` adicionado e aplicado ao banco local; `CHANGELOG.md` atualizado; testes novos cobrindo o bug de engolfamento, PATCH conflitante, corrida concorrente, disponibilidade e lote.

`make verify` (typecheck + lint + build + test) passa limpo — 74 testes, 0 falhas.
